summary: Firefly III is a self-hosted personal-finance double-entry accounting manager (Laravel/PHP): users track accounts, transactions (group/journal/split), budgets+limits+auto-budgets, piggy banks, bills, categories, tags, recurring transactions, rules+rule groups, webhooks, currencies+exchange rates, preferences and configuration, with full CRUD over the JSON API (/v1/*) and web UI.

_no_edges.why: read-only; finds matching journals via rule engine, mutates nothing; edge coverage only via its own guard
internal; reads by name then conditionally inserts; no external wall beyond repository setUser
internal helper; find-or-create; no auth surface of its own
signout endpoint: no persistence mutation, no pre-checks beyond an authenticated session, calls nothing of its own (app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php:120)
